STEP_1: open the camera on the device you're adding
STEP_3: tap the link to open solstone
PAIR_NETWORK_LINE: this device needs to be on your network (or your VPN) to pair. expires in {time}.
PAIR_PUBLIC_ADDRESS_LINE: this pairing link uses your public address. expires in {time}.
PAIR_LINK_ADDRESSES_LINE: this code points your devices to:
DETAILS_DISCLOSURE: verify this is really your home
CA_FP_NOTE: the device checks this when it scans, so no one on your wifi can impersonate home.
EXPIRED_BUTTON: this code expired. show a new one
WINDOW_CLOSED_BUTTON: pairing window closed. open a new one
SUCCESS_HEADING: "{label}" is now paired with your journal
PAIR_ERROR_BODY: can't start pairing. your journal isn't reachable on a network address yet.
SUCCESS_VERIFY_NOTE: check the device you just paired — it should show this same journal mark. didn't do this?
SUCCESS_VERIFY_NOTE_ANYWHERE: this device can now reach your journal from anywhere. didn't do this?
HERO_BODY: your journal lives here, on this device. to read it from your phone or laptop, that device needs a way to reach it. right now it can be reached on your home network.

STATUS_SENTENCES.direct_online: your journal is reachable on your network.
STATUS_SENTENCES.direct_online_vpn: your journal is reachable on your network and over your VPN.
STATUS_SENTENCES.offline: can't reach your journal right now.
STATUS_SENTENCES.lan_unreachable: your journal is running, but devices can't reach it to pair yet.
STATUS_SENTENCES.spl_online: your journal is reachable from anywhere.
STATUS_SENTENCES.spl_not_enrolled: your private network isn't set up yet. devices can't connect from away.
STATUS_SENTENCES.spl_finishing_setup: finishing setup with your private network…
STATUS_SENTENCES.spl_offline: this computer isn't reaching the network right now. devices can't connect from away. on your home wifi they still work.
STATUS_SENTENCES.direct_closed: your journal is closed to devices on your network.

BRANDLOCK_LINE: your journal is always private, only yours.
REACH_SELECTOR_TITLE: how your devices reach your journal
REACH_SELECTOR_HINT: your choice, switch anytime. either way, what syncs is end-to-end encrypted and only your devices can read it.
MODE_BYO_DESC: your devices reach your journal over your own network: same wifi, or your own VPN. the default.
MODE_BYO_DISCLOSURE: sol pbc is never in the path
MODE_HOSTED_DESC: reach your journal from anywhere, through a relay sol pbc runs for you.
MODE_BYO_BODY_NOTE: your journal stays on this device. your other devices connect straight to it. nothing routes through sol pbc.
MODE_HOSTED_SETUP_NOTE: your journal stays on this device; the relay only passes along encrypted traffic it can't read.
APP_ONOFF_SUB_BYO: on, reachable over your own network
REACH_HOME_ADDRESS_UNUSABLE: this saved address can't be used for pairing.
REACH_HOST_ADDRESS_NOTE: this can be an address on your own network, your VPN, or a public address you've exported yourself, for example by forwarding a port on your router.
REACH_HOME_CANDIDATES_LABEL: choose an address for your journal
REACH_HOME_CANDIDATES_REFRESH_FAIL: saved, but couldn't refresh. showing the last confirmed address.
REACH_HOME_CANDIDATES_UNAVAILABLE: couldn't check your journal's addresses. you can still type one below.
REACH_SPL_ACTIVE_BODY: your devices reach your journal over the internet, wherever you are.
REACH_SPL_TRUST_LINE: the connection is end-to-end encrypted. sol pbc and Cloudflare can see that your device and home met, and nothing inside.
REACH_SPL_MANAGE_LABEL: manage your private network in the services portal →
REACH_SPL_CONNECTING_NOTE: your journal is connecting. this is usually quick.
PAIR_START_PAIRED_DEVICE_BODY: pairing didn't start. finish pairing this device first.
PRIVATE_LINK_DISABLE_CONFIRM: turn off your private network? your devices will only reach your journal over your own network, on the same wifi or your own VPN, until you turn it back on.
PRIVATE_LINK_SETUP_SUCCESS: your private network is on. your devices can reach your journal from anywhere.
PRIVATE_LINK_SETUP_FAILED: couldn't finish setting up your private network.
PRIVATE_LINK_NEEDS_SUBSCRIPTION_DETAIL: your consent is saved. finish turning it on in the services portal, then turn it on here again.
PRIVATE_LINK_DISABLE_SUCCESS: your private network is off. devices connect directly again.
PRIVATE_LINK_DISABLE_FAILED: couldn't turn off your private network. it's still on. try again.
PRIVATE_LINK_NEEDS_REPAIR: your private network needs setting up again.
PRIVATE_LINK_TIMEOUT_BODY: your private network didn't answer in time. try again.
DEVICE_EMPTY_BODY: pair a device to read your journal on the go.
REFRESH_FAIL_NOTICE: showing the last state we saw
UNPAIR_BODY: this device loses access to your journal immediately and can't reconnect until you pair it again. anything stored on the device stays on the device.
UNPAIR_AMBIGUOUS_LABEL_HEADER_FORMAT: more than one device is named '{label}'. pick the one you mean and run its command:
APP_ONOFF_SUB_BYO_CLOSED: on, closed to devices on your network
LOCAL_NETWORK_THIS_PC: closed to devices on your network
LOCAL_NETWORK_THIS_PC_NOTE: the solstone app on this computer can still pair from "pair a device", and so can another device once your private network is on. to pair a phone or another computer over your own network, open your journal to it.
LOCAL_NETWORK_WINDOWS_ASKS_NOTE: windows may then ask whether journal can use the network, and on a standard account an administrator has to allow it.
LOCAL_NETWORK_OPEN_CTA: open to devices on your network
LOCAL_NETWORK_OPEN: open to devices on your network
LOCAL_NETWORK_OPEN_NOTE: devices on the same network can pair with your journal directly.
LOCAL_NETWORK_FIREWALL_NOTE: if windows didn't ask and a device still can't reach your journal, an earlier choice in windows may be blocking journal. an administrator can allow it in Windows Security, under Firewall & network protection › Allow an app through firewall.
LOCAL_NETWORK_CLOSE_CTA: close to devices on your network
LOCAL_NETWORK_CLOSE_CONFIRM: close your journal to devices on your network? any device connected over your network now will disconnect.
LOCAL_NETWORK_NOT_REACHABLE: devices can't reach your journal right now.
LOCAL_NETWORK_FAILED: couldn't change whether your journal is open to devices on your network. try again.
PAIR_LOCAL_NETWORK_CLOSED_BODY: your journal is closed to devices on your network, so another device can't reach it directly yet. pair the solstone app on this computer, open your journal to devices on your network, or set up the relay sol pbc runs to pair from anywhere.
PAIR_THIS_COMPUTER_CTA: pair the solstone app on this computer
PAIR_THIS_COMPUTER_LINE: this link works only for the solstone app on this computer. expires in {time}.
MODE_BYO_DESC_CLOSED: your devices reach your journal over your own network, same wifi or your own VPN, once you open it to them.
PRIVATE_LINK_DISABLE_CONFIRM_CLOSED: turn off your private network? your journal is closed to devices on your network, so your other devices can't reach it until you open it to your network or turn the private network back on.
PRIVATE_LINK_DISABLE_SUCCESS_CLOSED: your private network is off. your journal is closed to devices on your network, so your other devices can't reach it.
LOCAL_NETWORK_AGENTS_NOTE: your journal stays open to devices on your network while "agents on your network" is on.
LOCAL_NETWORK_AGENTS_CLOSES_NOTE: it closes to them when you turn that off in agents.
